description: Department of Local Government - Eastern Province - Notify the First Meeting of the Lahugala PS and 31 other Local Government Bodies in Eastern Province
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the schedule for the first meetings of various Local Authorities for the purpose of electing Mayors/Deputy Mayors or Chairmen/Vice Chairmen. This content directly relates to electoral processes at the local government level, specifically the organization of meetings to elect officials, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
